<codebase path="packages/rialto-catalog">
  <section priority="medium" role="scripts">
  <file path="scripts/gen-ui-bakeoff-lib.ts">
    export type ProviderId = "anthropic" | "openai" | "gemini";
    export interface ChatMessage {
      readonly role: "user" | "assistant";
      readonly content: string;
    }
    export type Effort = "default" | "low";
    export interface ProviderRequest {
      readonly system: string;
      readonly messages: readonly ChatMessage[];
      readonly maxOutputTokens: number;
      /** Set only for a non-default arm. */
      readonly effort?: Exclude<Effort, "default">;
    }
    export interface ProviderResponse {
      readonly text: string;
      /** Total input including cached tokens. */
      readonly inputTokens: number;
      readonly outputTokens: number;
      /** Subset of `inputTokens` served from the prompt cache. */
      readonly cacheReadTokens?: number;
      /** Subset of `inputTokens` written to the prompt cache. */
      readonly cacheWriteTokens?: number;
    }
    export interface Pricing {
      readonly inPerM: number;
      readonly outPerM: number;
      /**
       * Cache-read input rate. Required, not optional: an absent rate used to fall
       * back to the base rate, which silently overpriced cached tokens (#7236). A
       * vendor with no discount must say so by declaring the base rate explicitly.
       */
      readonly cachedInPerM: number;
      /** Cache-write input rate; absent means base input rate. */
      readonly cacheWritePerM?: number;
      /** Names the pricing tier a row reflects; shown in the report. */
      readonly tier?: string;
    }
    export interface Provider {
      readonly id: ProviderId;
      readonly label: string;
      readonly model: string;
      readonly pricing: Pricing;
      /** Whether the wire format can take an effort arm. Absent means yes. */
      readonly supportsEffort?: boolean;
      readonly call: (req: ProviderRequest) => Promise<ProviderResponse>;
    }
    export interface PromptResult {
      readonly provider: ProviderId;
      readonly arm?: Effort;
      readonly tier?: string;
      readonly prompt: string;
      readonly validFirstTry: boolean;
      readonly validAfterRepair: boolean;
      readonly inputTokens: number;
      readonly outputTokens: number;
      /** Cost as billed, cache reads at the cache-read rate. */
      readonly usd: number;
      /** Cold-start cost: all input at the base rate. */
      readonly uncachedUsd?: number;
      readonly error?: string;
    }
    export interface BakeoffReport {
      readonly results: readonly PromptResult[];
      readonly spentUsd: number;
      readonly maxUsd: number;
      readonly aborted: boolean;
      readonly abortReason?: string;
    }
    export const PRICING: Readonly<Record<ProviderId, Pricing>> = {
      // Claude Haiku 5.5: cache read is a tenth of base input, a 5-minute write is 1.25x.
      anthropic: { inPerM: 0.1, outPerM: 0.5, cachedInPerM: 0.01, cacheWritePerM: 0.125 },
      // GPT-6 Luna (developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, 2026-10-22, short context <=272K):
      // cached input $0.01; a cache write is $0.125 (30 min) / $0.25 (12 h). The harness only
      // reads implicit-cache hits, so the write rate is recorded but never applied.
      openai: { inPerM: 0.1, outPerM: 0.5, cachedInPerM: 0.01, cacheWritePerM: 0.125 },
      // Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, 2026-10-22, paid, text):
      // cached input $0.025. No per-write charge is published; explicit caches also bill storage
      // ($1.00/MTok-hour), which the harness does not use (implicit caching only).
      gemini: { inPerM: 0.25, outPerM: 1.5, cachedInPerM: 0.025, tier: "paid rates" },
    };
    export function geminiPricing(freeTier: boolean): Pricing {
      return freeTier ? { inPerM: 0, outPerM: 0, cachedInPerM: 0, tier: "free tier" } : PRICING.gemini;
    }
    interface Tokens {
      inputTokens: number;
      outputTokens: number;
      cacheReadTokens?: number;
      cacheWriteTokens?: number;
    }
    export function costUsd(tokens: Tokens, pricing: Pricing): number {
      const read = tokens.cacheReadTokens ?? 0;
      const write = tokens.cacheWriteTokens ?? 0;
      const plain = tokens.inputTokens - read - write;
      return (
        (plain * pricing.inPerM +
          read * pricing.cachedInPerM +
          write * (pricing.cacheWritePerM ?? pricing.inPerM) +
          tokens.outputTokens * pricing.outPerM) /
        1_000_000
      );
    }
    export function uncachedCostUsd(tokens: Tokens, pricing: Pricing): number {
      return costUsd({ inputTokens: tokens.inputTokens, outputTokens: tokens.outputTokens }, pricing);
    }
    export const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `${catalog.prompt()}\n\n${JSON_OUTPUT_INSTRUCTIONS}`;
    export type Validation = { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string };
    function extractJson(text: string): unknown {
      const fenced = /```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/.exec(text);
      return JSON.parse((fenced?.[1] ?? text).trim());
    }
    function formatIssues(error: {
      issues?: readonly { path: PropertyKey[]; message: string }[];
    }): string {
      const lines = (error.issues ?? []).slice(0, 8).map((i) => {
        const msg = i.message.length > 200 ? `${i.message.slice(0, 200)}…` : i.message;
        return `${i.path.map(String).join(".") || "(root)"}: ${msg}`;
      });
      return lines.join("\n").slice(0, MAX_FEEDBACK_CHARS);
    }
    export function validateModelOutput(text: string): Validation {
      let parsed: unknown;
      try {
        parsed = extractJson(text);
      } catch {
        return { ok: false, error: "Output was not valid JSON." };
      }
      const elements = Array.isArray(parsed)
        ? parsed
        : (parsed as { elements?: unknown } | null)?.elements;
      if (!Array.isArray(elements) || elements.length === 0) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Expected {"elements":[...]} with at least one element.' };
      }
      let result: ReturnType<typeof catalog.validate>;
      try {
        result = catalog.validate(flatToTree(elements as Parameters<typeof flatToTree>[0]));
      } catch (err) {
        // Malformed elements (e.g. null entries) are an invalid spec, not a provider error.
        return {
          ok: false,
          error: `Malformed elements: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
        };
      }
      if (result.success) return { ok: true };
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: formatIssues(result.error ?? {}) || "Spec failed catalog validation.",
      };
    }
    export class SpendLimitError extends Error {
      constructor(message: string) {
        super(message);
        this.name = "SpendLimitError";
      }
    }
    export function createSpendGuard(maxUsd: number) {
      let spent = 0;
      return {
        spent: () => spent,
        record: (usd: number) => {
          spent += usd;
        },
        assertCanSpend: (worstCaseUsd: number) => {
          if (spent + worstCaseUsd > maxUsd) {
            throw new SpendLimitError(
              `Spend guard: $${spent.toFixed(4)} spent + $${worstCaseUsd.toFixed(4)} worst case would exceed --max-usd $${maxUsd.toFixed(2)}`
            );
          }
        },
      };
    }
    type SpendGuard = ReturnType<typeof createSpendGuard>;
    function worstCaseUsd(provider: Provider, req: ProviderRequest): number {
      const chars = req.system.length + req.messages.reduce((n, m) => n + m.content.length, 0);
      // Worst case prices every input token at the dearest input rate (a cache write).
      const inRate = Math.max(provider.pricing.inPerM, provider.pricing.cacheWritePerM ?? 0);
      return (
        (Math.ceil(chars / CHARS_PER_TOKEN_ESTIMATE) * inRate +
          req.maxOutputTokens * provider.pricing.outPerM) /
        1_000_000
      );
    }
    async function guardedCall(provider: Provider, req: ProviderRequest, guard: SpendGuard) {
      guard.assertCanSpend(worstCaseUsd(provider, req));
      const res = await provider.call(req);
      const usd = costUsd(res, provider.pricing);
      guard.record(usd);
      return { res, usd, uncachedUsd: uncachedCostUsd(res, provider.pricing) };
    }
    function repairPrompt(error: string): string {
      return `The JSON failed validation:\n${error}\n\nReturn the corrected complete JSON object only.`;
    }
    async function runPrompt(
      provider: Provider,
      prompt: string,
      guard: SpendGuard,
      arm: Effort
    ): Promise<PromptResult> {
      const base = { provider: provider.id, arm, tier: provider.pricing.tier, prompt };
      const effort = arm === "default" ? {} : { effort: arm };
      const first = await guardedCall(
        provider,
        {
          system: SYSTEM_PROMPT,
          messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
          maxOutputTokens: MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
          ...effort,
        },
        guard
      );
      const v1 = validateModelOutput(first.res.text);
      const tally = {
        inputTokens: first.res.inputTokens,
        outputTokens: first.res.outputTokens,
        usd: first.usd,
        uncachedUsd: first.uncachedUsd,
      };
      if (v1.ok) return { ...base, validFirstTry: true, validAfterRepair: true, ...tally };
    
      let repair: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof guardedCall>>;
      try {
        repair = await guardedCall(
          provider,
          {
            system: SYSTEM_PROMPT,
            messages: [
              { role: "user", content: prompt },
              { role: "assistant", content: first.res.text },
              { role: "user", content: repairPrompt(v1.error) },
            ],
            maxOutputTokens: MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
            ...effort,
          },
          guard
        );
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof SpendLimitError) throw err;
        // The first call was paid for; keep its cost in the row.
        return { ...errorResult(provider, prompt, err, arm), ...tally };
      }
      return {
        ...base,
        validFirstTry: false,
        validAfterRepair: validateModelOutput(repair.res.text).ok,
        inputTokens: tally.inputTokens + repair.res.inputTokens,
        outputTokens: tally.outputTokens + repair.res.outputTokens,
        usd: tally.usd + repair.usd,
        uncachedUsd: tally.uncachedUsd + repair.uncachedUsd,
      };
    }
    function errorResult(
      provider: Provider,
      prompt: string,
      err: unknown,
      arm: Effort = "default"
    ): PromptResult {
      return {
        provider: provider.id,
        arm,
        tier: provider.pricing.tier,
        prompt,
        validFirstTry: false,
        validAfterRepair: false,
        inputTokens: 0,
        outputTokens: 0,
        usd: 0,
        uncachedUsd: 0,
        error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
      };
    }
    export async function runBakeoff(opts: {
      providers: readonly Provider[];
      prompts: readonly string[];
      maxUsd: number;
      /** One arm per effort, per provider that supports one. Defaults to the provider default only. */
      efforts?: readonly Effort[];
    }): Promise<BakeoffReport> {
      const guard = createSpendGuard(opts.maxUsd);
      const results: PromptResult[] = [];
      let abortReason: string | undefined;
    
      for (const provider of opts.providers) {
        const arms = (opts.efforts ?? ["default"]).filter(
          (e) => e === "default" || provider.supportsEffort !== false
        );
        for (const arm of arms) {
          let consecutiveErrors = 0;
          for (const prompt of opts.prompts) {
            if (consecutiveErrors >= MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ERRORS) break;
            try {
              results.push(await runPrompt(provider, prompt, guard, arm));
              consecutiveErrors = 0;
            } catch (err) {
              if (err instanceof SpendLimitError) {
                abortReason = err.message;
                break;
              }
              results.push(errorResult(provider, prompt, err, arm));
              consecutiveErrors += 1;
            }
          }
          if (abortReason) break;
        }
        if (abortReason) break;
      }
      return {
        results,
        spentUsd: guard.spent(),
        maxUsd: opts.maxUsd,
        aborted: abortReason !== undefined,
        ...(abortReason ? { abortReason } : {}),
      };
    }
    export function createStubProvider(opts: {
      id: ProviderId;
      prompts: readonly string[];
      label?: string;
      model?: string;
    }): Provider {
      return {
        id: opts.id,
        label: opts.label ?? `${opts.id} (stub)`,
        model: opts.model ?? "stub",
        pricing: PRICING[opts.id],
        call: async (req) => {
          const index = opts.prompts.indexOf(req.messages[0]?.content ?? "");
          const isRepair = req.messages.length > 1;
          const kind = index % 3;
          const text = kind === 0 || (kind === 1 && isRepair) ? STUB_VALID : STUB_INVALID;
          const chars = req.system.length + req.messages.reduce((n, m) => n + m.content.length, 0);
          return {
            text,
            inputTokens: Math.ceil(chars / 4),
            outputTokens: Math.ceil(text.length / 4),
            // The shared catalog prompt is what a warm cache serves.
            cacheReadTokens: Math.min(Math.ceil(req.system.length / 4), Math.ceil(chars / 4)),
          };
        },
      };
    }
    export interface ProviderSummary {
      readonly provider: ProviderId;
      readonly arm: Effort;
      readonly tier?: string;
      readonly n: number;
      readonly errors: number;
      readonly validFirstTryPct: number;
      readonly validAfterRepairPct: number;
      readonly meanInputTokens: number;
      readonly meanOutputTokens: number;
      readonly totalUsd: number;
      readonly uncachedUsd: number;
      readonly projectedUsdPer1k: number;
      readonly uncachedProjectedUsdPer1k: number;
    }
    export function summarize(results: readonly PromptResult[]): ProviderSummary[] {
      const keys = [...new Set(results.map((r) => `${r.provider}|${r.arm ?? "default"}`))];
      return keys.map((key) => {
        const [provider, arm] = key.split("|") as [ProviderId, Effort];
        const rows = results.filter((r) => r.provider === provider && (r.arm ?? "default") === arm);
        const n = rows.length;
        const pct = (count: number) => (count / n) * 100;
        const mean = (pick: (r: PromptResult) => number) => rows.reduce((s, r) => s + pick(r), 0) / n;
        const totalUsd = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.usd, 0);
        const uncachedUsd = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.uncachedUsd ?? r.usd), 0);
        return {
          provider,
          arm,
          ...(rows[0]?.tier ? { tier: rows[0].tier } : {}),
          n,
          errors: rows.filter((r) => r.error !== undefined).length,
          validFirstTryPct: pct(rows.filter((r) => r.validFirstTry).length),
          validAfterRepairPct: pct(rows.filter((r) => r.validAfterRepair).length),
          meanInputTokens: mean((r) => r.inputTokens),
          meanOutputTokens: mean((r) => r.outputTokens),
          totalUsd,
          uncachedUsd,
          projectedUsdPer1k: (totalUsd / n) * 1000,
          uncachedProjectedUsdPer1k: (uncachedUsd / n) * 1000,
        };
      });
    }
    export function formatTable(summaries: readonly ProviderSummary[]): string {
      const header =
        "| Provider | Effort | Valid 1st try | Valid after repair | Mean in tok | Mean out tok | Cached $ | Uncached $ | Cached $/1k gens | Uncached $/1k gens | Errors |";
      const sep = "|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|";
      const rows = summaries.map((s) => {
        const free = s.tier === "free tier";
        const usd = (v: number, digits: number) => (free ? "$0 (free tier)" : `$${v.toFixed(digits)}`);
        const name = s.tier ? `${s.provider} (${s.tier})` : s.provider;
        return `| ${name} | ${s.arm} | ${s.validFirstTryPct.toFixed(0)}% | ${s.validAfterRepairPct.toFixed(0)}% | ${s.meanInputTokens.toFixed(0)} | ${s.meanOutputTokens.toFixed(0)} | ${usd(s.totalUsd, 4)} | ${usd(s.uncachedUsd, 4)} | ${usd(s.projectedUsdPer1k, 2)} | ${usd(s.uncachedProjectedUsdPer1k, 2)} | ${s.errors}/${s.n} |`;
      });
      return [header, sep, ...rows].join("\n");
    }

  <file path="scripts/gen-ui-bakeoff-providers.ts">
    type FetchLike = typeof fetch;
    export const DEFAULT_MODELS: Readonly<Record<ProviderId, string>> = {
      anthropic: "claude-haiku-5-5",
      openai: "gpt-6-luna",
      gemini: "gemini-3.1-flash-lite",
    };
    export const ENV_KEYS: Readonly<Record<ProviderId, string>> = {
      anthropic: "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
      openai: "OPENAI_API_KEY",
      gemini: "GEMINI_API_KEY",
    };
    interface Wire {
      readonly url: string;
      readonly headers: Record<string, string>;
      readonly body: unknown;
    }
    function anthropicWire(key: string, model: string, req: ProviderRequest): Wire {
      return {
        url: "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages",
        headers: { "x-api-key": key, "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01" },
        body: {
          model,
          max_tokens: req.maxOutputTokens,
          // Same ephemeral cache breakpoint gen-runner.ts sets on the system message.
          system: [{ type: "text", text: req.system, cache_control: { type: "ephemeral" } }],
          messages: req.messages,
          ...(req.effort ? { output_config: { effort: req.effort } } : {}),
        },
      };
    }
    function openaiWire(key: string, model: string, req: ProviderRequest): Wire {
      return {
        url: "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
        headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${key}` },
        body: {
          model,
          max_completion_tokens: req.maxOutputTokens,
          response_format: { type: "json_object" },
          ...(req.effort ? { reasoning_effort: req.effort } : {}),
          messages: [{ role: "system", content: req.system }, ...req.messages],
        },
      };
    }
    function geminiWire(key: string, model: string, req: ProviderRequest): Wire {
      return {
        url: `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${encodeURIComponent(model)}:generateContent`,
        headers: { "x-goog-api-key": key },
        body: {
          systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: req.system }] },
          contents: req.messages.map((m) => ({
            role: m.role === "assistant" ? "model" : "user",
            parts: [{ text: m.content }],
          })),
          generationConfig: {
            maxOutputTokens: req.maxOutputTokens,
            responseMimeType: "application/json",
            ...(req.effort ? { thinkingConfig: { thinkingLevel: req.effort } } : {}),
          },
        },
      };
    }
    type Parsed = ProviderResponse;
    interface AnthropicJson {
      content?: { type?: string; text?: string }[];
      usage?: {
        input_tokens?: number;
        output_tokens?: number;
        cache_read_input_tokens?: number;
        cache_creation_input_tokens?: number;
      };
    }
    interface OpenAiJson {
      choices?: { message?: { content?: string } }[];
      usage?: {
        prompt_tokens?: number;
        completion_tokens?: number;
        prompt_tokens_details?: { cached_tokens?: number };
      };
    }
    interface GeminiJson {
      candidates?: { content?: { parts?: { text?: string }[] } }[];
      usageMetadata?: {
        promptTokenCount?: number;
        candidatesTokenCount?: number;
        cachedContentTokenCount?: number;
        thoughtsTokenCount?: number;
      };
    }
    type SleepLike = (ms: number) => Promise<void>;
    function retryDelayMs(res: Response): number {
      const header = Number(res.headers.get("retry-after"));
      if (!Number.isFinite(header) || header <= 0) return DEFAULT_RETRY_DELAY_MS;
      return Math.min(header * 1000, MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
    }
    export function createProvider(
      id: ProviderId,
      apiKey: string,
      fetchImpl: FetchLike = fetch,
      model: string = DEFAULT_MODELS[id],
      pricing: Pricing = PRICING[id],
      sleep: SleepLike = realSleep
    ): Provider {
      const redact = (s: string) => s.split(apiKey).join("[redacted]");
      return {
        id,
        label: LABELS[id],
        model,
        pricing,
        call: async (req) => {
          const wire = WIRES[id](apiKey, model, req);
          let res: Response;
          for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt += 1) {
            res = await fetchImpl(wire.url, {
              method: "POST",
              headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...wire.headers },
              body: JSON.stringify(wire.body),
            });
            if (res.status !== 429 || attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) break;
            await sleep(retryDelayMs(res));
          }
          if (!res.ok) {
            const detail = redact((await res.text()).slice(0, 300));
            throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} from ${id}: ${detail}`);
          }
          const parse = PARSERS[id];
          return parse(await res.json());
        },
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="scripts/gen-ui-bakeoff.ts">
    function loadPrompts(limit: number | undefined): string[] {
      const url = new URL("./fixtures/gen-ui-bakeoff-prompts.json", import.meta.url);
      const all = JSON.parse(readFileSync(url, "utf8")) as string[];
      return limit === undefined ? all : all.slice(0, limit);
    }
    function resolveProviders(
      ids: readonly ProviderId[],
      dryRun: boolean,
      prompts: string[],
      geminiFree: boolean
    ): Provider[] {
      if (dryRun)
        return ids.map((id) => ({
          ...createStubProvider({ id, prompts }),
          ...(id === "gemini" ? { pricing: geminiPricing(geminiFree) } : {}),
        }));
      const providers: Provider[] = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const key = process.env[ENV_KEYS[id]];
        if (!key) {
          console.error(`skip ${id}: ${ENV_KEYS[id]} is not set`);
          continue;
        }
        providers.push(
          id === "gemini"
            ? createProvider(id, key, fetch, undefined, geminiPricing(geminiFree))
            : createProvider(id, key)
        );
      }
      return providers;
    }
    async function main(): Promise<number> {
      const { values } = parseArgs({
        // pnpm forwards a literal `--` before script args; drop it so flags still parse.
        args: process.argv.slice(2).filter((a) => a !== "--"),
        options: {
          "dry-run": { type: "boolean", default: false },
          "max-usd": { type: "string", default: String(DEFAULT_MAX_USD) },
          out: { type: "string" },
          providers: { type: "string" },
          limit: { type: "string" },
          efforts: { type: "string", default: "default,low" },
          "gemini-free-tier": { type: "boolean", default: false },
        },
        allowPositionals: true,
      });
      const maxUsd = Number(values["max-usd"]);
      if (!Number.isFinite(maxUsd) || maxUsd < 0) {
        console.error("--max-usd must be a non-negative number");
        return 2;
      }
      const ids = values.providers
        ? values.providers.split(",").filter((p): p is ProviderId => IDS.includes(p as ProviderId))
        : IDS;
      const efforts = values.efforts
        .split(",")
        .filter((e): e is Effort => e === "default" || e === "low");
      if (efforts.length === 0) {
        console.error("--efforts must include default and/or low");
        return 2;
      }
      const prompts = loadPrompts(values.limit ? Number(values.limit) : undefined);
      const anyKey = IDS.some((id) => process.env[ENV_KEYS[id]]);
      const dryRun = values["dry-run"] || !anyKey;
      if (dryRun && !values["dry-run"])
        console.error("no provider keys found — running --dry-run with stubs");
    
      const providers = resolveProviders(ids, dryRun, prompts, values["gemini-free-tier"]);
      if (providers.length === 0) {
        console.error("no providers to run");
        return 2;
      }
      const report = await runBakeoff({ providers, prompts, maxUsd, efforts });
      const summaries = summarize(report.results);
      process.stdout.write(
        `${dryRun ? "DRY RUN (stub providers, canned outputs)\n\n" : ""}${formatTable(summaries)}\n`
      );
      process.stdout.write(
        `\nspent $${report.spentUsd.toFixed(4)} of $${maxUsd.toFixed(2)} cap${report.aborted ? ` — ABORTED: ${report.abortReason}` : ""}\n`
      );
      if (values.out) {
        const models = Object.fromEntries(providers.map((p) => [p.id, p.model]));
        const json = { generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), dryRun, models, summaries, ...report };
        writeFileSync(values.out, `${JSON.stringify(json, null, 2)}\n`);
      }
      return report.aborted ? 1 : 0;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="scripts/generate-catalog.ts">
    function findCatalogMetaFiles(dir: string): string[] {
      const found: string[] = [];
      for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
        const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
          found.push(...findCatalogMetaFiles(full));
        } else if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith(".catalog.ts")) {
          found.push(full);
        }
      }
      return found;
    }
    async function loadCatalogMeta(file: string): Promise<CatalogMeta> {
      const mod = (await import(pathToFileURL(file).href)) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const meta = Object.values(mod).find(
        (v): v is CatalogMeta =>
          typeof v === "object" && v !== null && typeof (v as CatalogMeta).name === "string"
      );
      if (!meta) {
        throw new Error(`No CatalogMeta export found in ${file}`);
      }
      return meta;
    }
    function stripUndefined(typeStr: string): { inner: string; wasOptional: boolean } {
      const parts = typeStr.split(" | ").map((p) => p.trim());
      const withoutUndefined = parts.filter((p) => p !== "undefined");
      const wasOptional = withoutUndefined.length < parts.length;
      return { inner: withoutUndefined.join(" | "), wasOptional };
    }
    export function mapTypeToZod(
      typeStr: string,
      isOptional: boolean,
      maxLen: number | undefined
    ): string | null {
      const { inner, wasOptional } = stripUndefined(typeStr);
      const optional = isOptional || wasOptional;
    
      // Skip function types
      if (inner.includes("=>")) {
        return null;
      }
    
      // Map ReactNode / JSX types to string (for catalog purpose)
      if (
        inner.includes("ReactNode") ||
        inner.includes("JSX.Element") ||
        inner === "Element" ||
        inner === "ReactNode"
      ) {
        const schema = maxLen !== undefined ? `z.string().max(${maxLen})` : "z.string()";
        return optional ? `${schema}.optional()` : schema;
      }
    
      // Skip complex object/array types that reference Rialto interfaces or ElementType
      if (
        inner.includes("[]") ||
        inner.startsWith("Column<") ||
        inner.includes("ComponentClass") ||
        inner.includes("FunctionComponent") ||
        inner.includes("Ref<") ||
        inner.includes("ForwardedRef")
      ) {
        return null;
      }
    
      // Boolean (expanded as "false | true" by TS compiler)
      if (inner === "boolean" || inner === "false | true" || inner === "true | false") {
        const schema = "z.boolean()";
        return optional ? `${schema}.optional()` : schema;
      }
    
      // Number
      if (inner === "number") {
        const schema = "z.number()";
        return optional ? `${schema}.optional()` : schema;
      }
    
      // String (plain)
      if (inner === "string") {
        const schema = maxLen !== undefined ? `z.string().max(${maxLen})` : "z.string()";
        return optional ? `${schema}.optional()` : schema;
      }
    
      // Union of string literals: "a" | "b" | "c"
      const unionParts = inner.split(" | ").map((p) => p.trim());
      if (
        unionParts.length >= 2 &&
        unionParts.every(
          (p) => (p.startsWith('"') && p.endsWith('"')) || (p.startsWith("'") && p.endsWith("'"))
        )
      ) {
        const values = unionParts.map((p) => `"${p.replace(/^['"]/, "").replace(/['"]$/, "")}"`);
        const schema = `z.enum([${values.join(", ")}])`;
        return optional ? `${schema}.optional()` : schema;
      }
    
      // Unrecognized — warn and skip
      console.warn(`[generate-catalog] Skipping unrecognized type "${inner}"`);
      return null;
    }
    interface PropSchema {
      propName: string;
      zodExpr: string;
    }
    export function buildComponentSchemas(
      canonicalComponents: ComponentMetadata[],
      metas: Map<string, CatalogMeta>
    ): Map<string, PropSchema[]> {
      const byName = new Map(canonicalComponents.map((c) => [c.name, c]));
      const result = new Map<string, PropSchema[]>();
    
      for (const [name, meta] of metas.entries()) {
        // Skip components handled by hardcodedSchemaLines (e.g. Toast)
        if (COMPONENT_ALIAS[name] !== undefined) continue;
    
        const comp = byName.get(name);
        if (!comp) {
          console.warn(`[generate-catalog] Component ${name} not found in canonical model`);
          continue;
        }
    
        const propSchemas: PropSchema[] = [];
    
        for (const prop of comp.props) {
          // Skip HTML-inherited utility props
          if (["className", "style", "id", "key"].includes(prop.name)) continue;
          // Only include props declared in rialto source
          if (!prop.declaredInRialto) continue;
    
          // An explicit prop schema from the meta wins over the inferred mapping.
          // This is how array-of-object data props (Tabs.tabs, Select.options,
          // Table.columns/data, ...) get a schema at all — mapTypeToZod returns
          // null for `[]`/`Column<`/function types and would otherwise skip them.
          const explicit = meta.propSchemas?.[prop.name];
          if (explicit !== undefined) {
            propSchemas.push({ propName: prop.name, zodExpr: explicit });
            continue;
          }
    
          const isOptional = !prop.required;
          const maxLen = meta.charLimits?.[prop.name];
          const zodExpr = mapTypeToZod(prop.resolvedType, isOptional, maxLen);
    
          if (zodExpr === null) continue;
    
          propSchemas.push({ propName: prop.name, zodExpr });
        }
    
        // Fold in any declared prop schemas whose prop the introspected interface
        // did not surface (defensive: keeps a declared shape even if the canonical
        // model omits the prop). A stale declaration surfaces as an extra field
        // rather than being silently dropped.
        if (meta.propSchemas) {
          const present = new Set(propSchemas.map((p) => p.propName));
          for (const [propName, zodExpr] of Object.entries(meta.propSchemas)) {
            if (!present.has(propName)) {
              propSchemas.push({ propName, zodExpr });
            }
          }
        }
    
        result.set(name, propSchemas);
      }
    
      return result;
    }
    function hardcodedSchemaLines(metas: Map<string, CatalogMeta>): Record<string, string[]> {
      const toast = metas.get("Toast");
      const titleMax = toast?.charLimits?.title ?? 50;
      const descMax = toast?.charLimits?.description ?? 120;
      return {
        Toast: [
          "  Toast: z.object({",
          `    title: z.string().max(${titleMax}),`,
          `    description: z.string().max(${descMax}).optional(),`,
          '    variant: z.enum(["default", "success", "error", "accent"]).optional(),',
          "    duration: z.number().optional(),",
          "  }),",
        ],
      };
    }
    function formatGeneratedSchemas(
      componentSchemas: Map<string, PropSchema[]>,
      hardcoded: Record<string, string[]>
    ): string {
      const lines: string[] = [
        "// AUTO-GENERATED -- do not edit. Run: pnpm --filter @mbe/rialto-catalog generate",
        'import { z } from "zod";',
        "",
        "export const generatedSchemas = {",
      ];
    
      const allNames = new Set([...componentSchemas.keys(), ...Object.keys(hardcoded)]);
      const sortedNames = Array.from(allNames).sort();
    
      for (const componentName of sortedNames) {
        if (hardcoded[componentName]) {
          for (const line of hardcoded[componentName]!) {
            lines.push(line);
          }
          continue;
        }
    
        const props = componentSchemas.get(componentName)!;
        if (props.length === 0) {
          lines.push(`  ${componentName}: z.object({}),`);
        } else {
          lines.push(`  ${componentName}: z.object({`);
          for (const { propName, zodExpr } of props) {
            lines.push(
              `    ${/^[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*$/.test(propName) ? propName : JSON.stringify(propName)}: ${zodExpr},`
            );
          }
          lines.push(`  }),`);
        }
      }
    
      lines.push("} as const;");
      lines.push("");
    
      return lines.join("\n");
    }
    function inlineRecord(record: Readonly<Record<string, string | number>>): string {
      const entries = Object.entries(record).map(([k, v]) => {
        const key = /^[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*$/.test(k) ? k : JSON.stringify(k);
        return `${key}: ${JSON.stringify(v)}`;
      });
      return `{ ${entries.join(", ")} }`;
    }
    function formatGeneratedCatalog(metas: Map<string, CatalogMeta>): string {
      const lines: string[] = [
        "// AUTO-GENERATED -- do not edit. Run: pnpm --filter @mbe/rialto-catalog generate",
        "// Co-located metadata from packages/rialto/src/components/<Component>/<Component>.catalog.ts",
        'import type { CatalogMeta } from "./catalog-meta.js";',
        "",
        "export const catalogMeta: Record<string, CatalogMeta> = {",
      ];
    
      for (const name of Array.from(metas.keys()).sort()) {
        const meta = metas.get(name)!;
        lines.push(`  ${name}: {`);
        lines.push(`    name: ${JSON.stringify(meta.name)},`);
        if (meta.include === false) {
          lines.push("    include: false,");
        }
        lines.push(`    description:`);
        lines.push(`      ${JSON.stringify(meta.description)},`);
        if (meta.slots && meta.slots.length > 0) {
          lines.push(`    slots: ${JSON.stringify(meta.slots)},`);
        }
        if (meta.charLimits && Object.keys(meta.charLimits).length > 0) {
          lines.push(`    charLimits: ${inlineRecord(meta.charLimits)},`);
        }
        if (meta.aliases && Object.keys(meta.aliases).length > 0) {
          lines.push(`    aliases: ${inlineRecord(meta.aliases)},`);
        }
        lines.push("  },");
      }
    
      lines.push("};");
      lines.push("");
    
      return lines.join("\n");
    }
    async function main() {
      const packageRoot = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
      const rialtoRoot = path.resolve(packageRoot, "../rialto");
      const rialtoComponentsDir = path.join(rialtoRoot, "src/components");
    
      const schemasOut = process.env.OUTPUT_FILE
        ? path.resolve(process.cwd(), process.env.OUTPUT_FILE)
        : path.join(packageRoot, "src/generated-schemas.ts");
      const catalogOut = process.env.CATALOG_OUTPUT_FILE
        ? path.resolve(process.cwd(), process.env.CATALOG_OUTPUT_FILE)
        : path.join(packageRoot, "src/generated-catalog.ts");
    
      // 1. Discover + load the co-located metadata — the single source of truth.
      const metaFiles = findCatalogMetaFiles(rialtoComponentsDir);
      const metas = new Map<string, CatalogMeta>();
      for (const file of metaFiles) {
        const meta = await loadCatalogMeta(file);
        metas.set(meta.name, meta);
      }
    
      if (metas.size === 0) {
        console.error("No *.catalog.ts metadata files found — something is wrong");
        process.exit(1);
      }
    
      // 2. Get typed component model from the canonical module — ONE parse, shared
      //    with generate-registry.ts, generate-manifest.ts, and generate-exports.ts.
      const canonicalComponents = introspectComponents(rialtoRoot);
    
      // 3. Build Zod schemas from the canonical model, honoring meta char limits.
      const componentSchemas = buildComponentSchemas(canonicalComponents, metas);
    
      const hardcoded = hardcodedSchemaLines(metas);
    
      if (componentSchemas.size === 0 && Object.keys(hardcoded).length === 0) {
        console.error("No component schemas extracted — something is wrong");
        process.exit(1);
      }
    
      // 4. Emit both artifacts from the single source.
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(schemasOut), { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(schemasOut, formatGeneratedSchemas(componentSchemas, hardcoded), "utf-8");
    
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(catalogOut), { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(catalogOut, formatGeneratedCatalog(metas), "utf-8");
    
      console.info(
        `Generated catalog: ${metas.size} components → ${path.relative(packageRoot, schemasOut)}, ${path.relative(packageRoot, catalogOut)}`
      );
      console.info(`Components: ${Array.from(metas.keys()).sort().join(", ")}`);
    }
  </file>
  </section>
  <section priority="medium" role="src">
  <file path="src/catalog-meta.ts">
    export type CatalogCharLimits = Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
    export type CatalogAliases = Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    export interface CatalogMeta {
      /** Component display name — must match the Rialto barrel export. */
      readonly name: string;
      /** Whether this component is offered to the AI for generation. Defaults to true. */
      readonly include?: boolean;
      /** Usage-oriented description telling the AI WHEN to use the component. */
      readonly description: string;
      /** Named slot keys — use `["default"]` for a children slot. */
      readonly slots?: readonly string[];
      /** Per-prop character limits folded into the generated Zod schema. */
      readonly charLimits?: CatalogCharLimits;
      /** Declared AI prop aliases handled by a hand-written registry adapter. */
      readonly aliases?: CatalogAliases;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/catalog.ts">
    export const catalog = defineCatalog(schema, {
      components,
      actions: {
        // setState, pushState, and removeState are BUILT-IN to the React schema.
        // Do NOT re-declare them here — they are auto-injected into prompts by json-render.
    
        validateForm: {
          params: z.object({ formId: z.string() }),
          description:
            "Validate all inputs in a form and show validation errors. Call before submitting to check required fields and constraints.",
        },
        navigate: {
          params: z.object({ path: z.string() }),
          description:
            "Navigate to a path within the app. Use for in-app routing after form submissions, button clicks, or list item selections.",
        },
      },
    });
  </file>

          "A time-ordered sequence of events, such as a guest's visit history. Each event has a title, optional description and timestamp (display text such as 7:30 PM), and status=completed|active|upcoming|error. Use compact=true for long lists.",
      },
      Toast: {
        name: "Toast",
        include: false,
        description:
          "Transient notification shown via useToast() hook. Use variant=success for completed actions, variant=error for failures, variant=accent for highlights. Always provide a title. Add description for additional context. Auto-dismisses after 4s by default.",
        charLimits: { title: 50, description: 120 },
      },
      Toggle: {
        name: "Toggle",
        description:
          "Binary on/off switch. Use for settings and preferences that take effect immediately without a submit button. Always provide a label describing what is being toggled.",
        charLimits: { label: 30 },
      },
    };
